title: [PDF] fifth-third-comerica-public-comments-2.pdf - Federal Reserve Board
summary: This document is a third-party public comment submitted to the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland opposing the proposed merger between Fifth Third Bancorp and Comerica Inc., citing alleged corporate governance failures, an active Delaware lawsuit, and ongoing investigations by the SEC, U.S. Treasury, and Senate Finance Committee. The commenter requests an extension of the public comment period, a public hearing, and delays to shareholder meetings. The document does not contain market structure analysis or macro catalysts relevant to trading or investment decisions.
key_points: This is a public comment opposing the Fifth Third-Comerica merger, not an official Federal Reserve document or policy statement
The commenter alleges severe governance failures at Comerica including CEO self-dealing, based on a Delaware lawsuit and HoldCo analysis reports
The Senate Finance Committee has issued information requests regarding Fifth Third's Direct Express program involvement
The commenter requests three specific actions: extended comment period, public hearing, and delayed shareholder meetings
Fifth Third responded to the allegations in two sentences, stating the litigation 'lacks merit'
The source is dated December 8, 2025, which is approximately 4 months prior to the TODAY date
